attributePolicy: Compare only native Attribute.isClientSyncable(): max_health, movement_speed, armor, luck. Native attack_damage and knockback_resistance are server-only; local bytecode saved as native-attributes-bytecode.txt. Server actual hurt remains authoritative for attack bonus.
remoteVanillaEffectsPolicy: Full remote-player vanilla effects are not broadcast by vanilla. Only owner full effect list compared; remote equipment uses real tracked entities. No synthetic effect-list parity required.
scope: Four jars, two real automated network clients, supplied QA gear/environment, not two human survival players or full modpack. Fixture-triggered native hurt explicitly identified per case; not all triggers are C2S.
